intro: Bishop DeLavey is a senior representative of the Church of the Holy Light stationed within the Petitioner's Chamber in Stormwind Keep. Acting on matters of state and faith, he quietly oversees sensitive court affairs that the Crown cannot publicly address.

p: While Archbishop Benedictus tends to the Cathedral of Light, Bishop DeLavey resides among the nobility and petitioners of Stormwind Keep. He serves as an ecclesiastical liaison to the court, balancing spiritual counsel with the kingdom's political reality. His position allows him to hear whispered rumors and delicate palace grievances before they ever reach the ears of Highlord Bolvar Fordragon or the young King Anduin.
